name: AcSeparatorCharacters
description: Used with the ComboBox.SeparatorCharacters property (Access) property to specify the separator displayed between values in combo boxes that are linked to multi-valued fields.

constants.name: acSeparatorCharactersSystemSeparator
constants.description: The List separator setting in the Regional and Language Options in the Windows Control Panel is used as the separator character.

constants.name: acSeparatorCharactersNewLine
constants.description: Each value appears on its own line.

constants.name: acSeparatorCharactersSemiColon
constants.description: A semicolon (;) is used as the separator character.

constants.name: acSeparatorCharactersComma
constants.description: A comma (,) is used as the separator character.
